title: POS Sessions
description: Till sessions opened and closed from the Point of Sale.

help.title: About POS sessions
help.overview: A session is one shift on a till, from the cash counted at opening to the cash counted at closing. Tills are opened and closed on Point of Sale; here you check each drawer afterwards.

sections.title: Each session shows
items: Opened while the till is selling; Closed once it's done, by the cashier or because the till was paused or switched off.
The opening cash, and every Cash In and Cash Out with its reason and who made it.
The cash the drawer should hold, the cash counted at closing, and the difference with its reason.
Its sales, which are listed under POS orders.
Sessions can't be created or changed here.
